title: GTA6 Fans Reportedly Measured Oxygen Levels Around Rockstar Campus
description: According to a report from IGN, YouTuber Mike ShowSha revealed that Rockstar developers said overeager GTA6 fans measured oxygen levels around their campus waiting for a trailer.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Fans Reportedly Measured Oxygen Levels Around Rockstar Campus

The anticipation surrounding Grand Theft Auto VI continues to push the boundaries of fan dedication. According to a recent report by IGN, Italian YouTuber Mike ShowSha shared an intriguing anecdote during a visit to Rockstar ahead of the company's major GTA 6 Netflix showcase, revealing just how far some overeager fans are willing to go.

### The Extreme Lengths of Community Anticipation

During his visit, developers told ShowSha that some extremely impatient fans literally measured the oxygen levels around the Rockstar campus in eager anticipation of a new trailer. While this sounds like an unbelievable internet myth, the developers noted it as a genuine encounter with the dedication—and perhaps obsession—of the game's massive player base.

As one of the most anticipated entertainment releases in history, everything related to Rockstar and GTA 6 is heavily scrutinized by the gaming community. This bizarre detail highlights the intense pressure and high expectations surrounding the title's marketing rollout. Industry analysts note that such extreme fan behaviors underscore the unprecedented cultural footprint the franchise holds, even as details remain scarce.

### Editor's Take

Measuring oxygen levels around a game developer's campus might sound like peak internet behavior, but it perfectly captures the unmatched hype surrounding GTA 6. While the wait is undoubtedly testing the community's patience, we hope fans keep things grounded and safe while awaiting the next official update from Rockstar.
